faq.a1: Your SmartStox subscription gives you access to our AI-driven trading platform that grows your wealth automatically through regulated brokers. You get a 3-month risk-free trial with the option for a full refund.
faq.q2: How Do I Sign Up for this Service?
faq.a2: You can sign up for this service by clicking on the REGISTER button and following the prompts. The process is simple: download the app, verify your identity, fund your account, and start earning.
faq.q3: How Do I Know that my Registration was Successful?
faq.a3: We shall send you a registration confirmation to your specified email address. You will also receive a welcome email with next steps to access your account.
faq.q4: How Do I Use this Service?
faq.a4: Your service and benefits are available online via this product website or the SmartStox Mobile Application. Once logged in, you can track your portfolio in real-time, view trades, and manage your settings.
faq.q5: What Do I Do if I Can't Login?
faq.a5: Login failures could be the result of various problems, such as a delay of your registration data to be available on our Login site. You are welcome to contact our CRM department via online chat or email in the meantime.
faq.a6: You may pay your software subscription fees via your MasterCard, VISA or CUP debit or credit card, or via USDT.
faq.q7: How Can I Increase the Value of my Benefits?
faq.a7: Your investment benefits may be increased subject to your disposable income and risk appetite. Additional funds can be added via your SmartStox Mobile APP to strategically enhance compounding potential.
faq.q8: How Do I Request a Refund?
faq.a8: A refund request should be done in writing to the client care email address as listed in the Contact Us section of this website, or via the self-service functions under Login. You may also cancel your trial during the first 30 days after the expiration of your 3-month trial for a full refund of any amounts paid.

treasuryManagement.subtitle: We don't Simply Trade Capital. We Steward it.
treasuryManagement.description: Trading is only one part of wealth creation. SmartStox actively manages capital positioning, ensuring strategic balance, controlled exposure, and long-term sustainability. Because protecting capital is as important as growing it.
treasuryManagement.card1_description1: Capital lives in these two USD accounts are continuously monitored to maintain optimum operational balance in your Primary Trading Account through a buffer of Trading Reserve Account. This ensures the system can operate effectively and sustainably in the trading environment to enable both rapid response trading and sustained growth accumulation.
treasuryManagement.card1_description2: As part of our end-of-day procedures, we ensure the system positions effectively and counter changing market conditions by maintaining a balance between your Primary Trading Reserve Account balances through automated reconciliation.
treasuryManagement.card2_description1: Every month, returns are directed with precision toward compound growth via asset diversification or liquidity. A portion can be channeled into carefully chosen equities and venture capital opportunities, while another section is allocated toward Real World Assets – adding depth, security, and long-term resilience to your portfolio.
treasuryManagement.card2_description2: SmartStox automatically allocates up to 50% of your capital to your Primary Trading & Reserve Investment Accounts, under the direction of your designated Broker.
treasuryManagement.card3_description1: Maintaining a cash position provides flexibility, allowing you to deploy returns or access capital when needed.
treasuryManagement.card3_description2: You could use your SmartStox APP to withdraw cash from your Transactional Profit Account, as allocated by your broker.
treasuryManagement.card3_description3: Withdraw profits to enhance lifestyle, create experiences, or support your goals.

items.title: BrightByte
paragraphs: BrightByte CyberFarming transforms renewable energy into high-performance digital production. This "cyber-agriculture" model treats computing power as a productive digital crop — cultivated using efficient energy systems and managed with institutional-grade financial discipline. The result is a resilient, scalable platform that converts renewable power into long-term digital value.

paragraphs: DigiProp is a blockchain-powered investment platform that enables affordable access to global real estate through the digitization of property assets. Specializing in storage unit investments across multiple jurisdictions, DigiProp allows investors to enter the market with low capital while benefiting from geographically diversified portfolios that reduce regional risk.
Through secure, transparent, and seamless blockchain technology, DigiProp simplifies property investment - making it accessible, efficient, and globally connected.

paragraphs: OryXFund is a next-generation investment platform that opens the door to blue-chip equity ownership through secure blockchain tokenisation. By converting shares in some of the world's most established companies into digital tokens, OryXFund enables investors to gain seamless, on-chain exposure to premium equities - fully backed 1:1 by the underlying securities.

This innovative approach combines the stability of traditional markets with the accessibility, transparency, and efficiency of blockchain technology, making global wealth creation more inclusive than ever.

paragraphs: PayPayYa is a next-generation digital payments platform designed for a truly global economy. It offers secure, user-friendly eWallets that enable individuals and businesses to send, receive, and store funds seamlessly across borders. With integrated crypto on-ramping and off-ramping, users can effortlessly move between traditional currencies and digital assets.
Combined with instant global fund transfers, PayPayYa delivers fast, flexible, and borderless financial access - empowering users to transact anywhere, anytime.

It's your gateway to earning, spending, and growing with Prosperian.
